name: exercises-mcp

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.description: Find exercises by name and filters. Every filter is optional and list_filters gives the values each one takes. Returns short summaries; get_exercise has the full exercise and guide.

query.description: Words in the exercise name, in any order, e.g. "squat" or "incline press"

muscle.description: Muscle group slug or name, e.g. "chest", "quadriceps", "lower-back"

withGuide.description: Only exercises that have a guide

language.description: Language of the names and guides: en or es

tools.name: get_exercise
tools.description: One exercise in full: muscles, equipment, a YouTube video when it has one, and its guide (summary, setup, steps, form cues, breathing, common mistakes, programming and safety notes, FAQ, and alternatives, easier and harder variations, each with its ID and why it fits).

exercise.description: The exercise ID, slug (e.g. "barbell-squat") or exact name

language.description: Language of the names and guides: en or es

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The values search_exercises filters take: muscle groups, equipment (with its family), categories, difficulty levels, force types and mechanics.

language.description: Language of the names and guides: en or es

instructions: Kinetic's open exercise dataset: 908 exercises in English and Spanish, 814 of them with a step-by-step guide that links to alternatives and to easier and harder variations, and most with a YouTube video. Use list_filters for the values search_exercises accepts, search_exercises to find exercises, and get_exercise for one exercise in full. Guides are general guidance, not medical advice.
